scope: Every finished cc-matrix run not already on the wall: the 2026-10-29 matrix of twenty sources (Alien Soldier to Waku Waku 7) by Claude Opus and Sonnet 5.5 (medium), Gemini 4 Argon (high), GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol and Terra (xhigh, max, ultra) and Muse Wonder 1 (max), plus eleven Rocket League runs from 2026-10-28.
dedupePolicy: A run was new only if the sha256 of its page matched no page in games/, no raw or output hash in data/import-registry.json and no source hash in docs/imports. Run ids from the 2026-10-29 batch no longer exist under runs/, so ids alone were not trusted; ingest also reported 0 duplicates.
filenamePolicy: The run's own GameTitle-SOURCE-model-effort-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.html with spaces as hyphens, & as and, other punctuation dropped, and a literal SOURCE replaced by the source title. Imported with scripts/ingest.mjs (provenance sourceKind cc-matrix-run, sourceDate = run startedAt).
capturePolicy: Real GPU (headless Windows Chrome over CDP), each game in a window of its own (tabs sharing a window are hidden and freeze), 960x720 encoded 640x480 JPEG quality 58: the title, then two frames of the attract demo the prompt requires after 10 s idle. Slow-loading pages were reshot with a longer timeline; games without a usable demo were driven into play with per-game key plans. Every strip was looked at.
notes: Talons & Seeds Primeval (Muse Wonder 1, Turok 2) was left out: it imports three/addons/renderers/webgpu/WebGPURenderer.js, which three r180 does not ship (404 on unpkg too), so the page never runs.

Strange Soldier and Amber Wrath (GPT-6 Astra) throw a WebGPU error (Invalid value used as weak map key) during their attract demo; their strips use frames from before it, Amber Wrath's from keyboard play. Imported unmodified.
Shells Out of Time declares its session as hub:mode/hub:players; its override carries sessionMode co-op and sessionPlayers 1-4.
Session games in co-op, versus or race seat 1–4 and carry their mode as a tag; parallel ones stay single player unless the game itself offers local multiplayer.
